top_categories.workout_context: Road-specific control matters at Škoda Ring of Clare Sportive. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 99 miles.
56ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Škoda Ring of Clare Sportive's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before July.
At Škoda Ring of Clare Sportive, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Škoda Ring of Clare Sportive. Train it until it feels boring.
5,577ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
At mile 60 of 99, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.

Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Škoda Ring of Clare Sportive. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
5,577ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on mixed terrain can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 99 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 99 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Škoda Ring of Clare Sportive’s 99 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Škoda Ring of Clare Sportive. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Škoda Ring of Clare Sportive rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.
